mab_initial.cause: Standalone verifier loaded config.yaml without the deployed Redis namespace; peer verification using runtime_config passed. Retried with CONFIG_PATH=models/full-v44/.docker/config.yaml.

api_restart_during_training.cause: CT bootstrap requires the training lock. Restart was retried after the actual CT run completed.

fresh_initial.cause: Redis profile pipeline socket timeout; all data/index/model stages passed. Added bounded idempotent connection/timeout retries and reran from a new empty data/model path.

exception_alias_regression.cause: Importing Redis ConnectionError under the built-in name changed the public write exception contract. Restored built-in ConnectionError and used explicit Redis aliases for retry catches.

submission_first_attempt.cause: Two checker processes were accidentally started because sandbox process visibility hid the first detached process. Both were explicitly terminated; their mixed output is not accepted as full test evidence. The focused failure was independently reproduced.

focused_sandbox_test.cause: TestClient waited in restricted sandbox; process terminated and rerun with the same host integration environment. 14 tests passed in 1.33 seconds. No test expectation changed.

manual_pass_copy_rejected.cause: Automatic approval rejected a command that would manually replace api_schemas status. Replaced with the actual Docker smoke verifier, then copied its full measured JSON byte-for-byte without editing checks.

final_browser_first.cause: Dashboard correctly showed the most recent demo A/B sidecar (20 users/arm, 2 days), overriding embedded full acceptance A/B. Restored display sidecar from the newly verified original full A/B without altering metrics; retained small demo and failed browser evidence.

final_browser_render_timing.cause: The full A/B JSON needed additional rendering time; the test read an empty panel. Waited for the actual full-population caption and CVR metric before applying the unchanged assertions. No service code or result values changed.
